title: Fix Remaining Type And Design Test Failures
description: Fix remaining 2 failing sketchpad tests (Type and Design). Type test: 2nd call to initHome within same page fails because zip import is silently ignored when kit already exists in store. Design test: kit page shows 0 rows after import despite 20s retry. Need to make initHome check store for existing kits and navigate directly, and make initDesign more robust with store-level checks.
